speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a pruritic rash along with fever, rhinorrhea, and headache. To better understand your symptoms, have you noticed any specific patterns on your rash, such as a rash that appears on your hands or feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 11-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing a mildly pruritic rash on her trunk and extremities for 2 days. One week ago, she developed symptoms of low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, and headache. A facial rash appeared 4 days later, sparing the perioral area.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scarlet Fever (likely caused by Group A Streptococcus).
